rule: Newcomers apprentice under a senior Keeper
texts: Each newcomer apprentices under a senior Keeper.
New apprentices do not tend a lantern alone.
The Council permits an apprentice to begin solo tending.

review.notes: Kind-level deontic norm in the reified-property form at the plain-norm TV 1.0/0.99 (no stated exemption, so not the defeasible 0.9/0.9); the single-lemma action needs no decomposition and a modal is not a quantifier word, so no QuantifierPhrase is due.

fields.sentence: Each newcomer apprentices under a senior Keeper.

review.notes: Explicit universal over a kind-naming subject gives the distributing rule at strength 1.0 / confidence 0.9 with the correctly shaped QuantifierPhrase companion, and the dependent indefinite "a senior Keeper" is a Skolem function of $x with its class atom, matching the forall-exists pattern. senior_keeper is a role-title fusion whose gradable modifier passes the predication test, so both the genus and the modifier genus are owed and emitted; Under is the licensed preposition-named oblique and the habitual present correctly carries no status atom.

fields.sentence: New apprentices do not tend a lantern alone.
parse: (: apprentice_no_tend_alone (Implication (And (Member $x apprentice) (Member $x new)) (And (Member (sk_tend $x) tend) (Agent (sk_tend $x) $x) (Patient (sk_tend $x) (sk_lantern $x)) (Member (sk_lantern $x) lantern) (Member $x alone))) (STV 0.0 0.9))

review.notes: Negated verbal generic as the distributing rule at strength 0.0 / confidence 0.9 with no QuantifierPhrase companion (no quantifier word), the adjectival restriction as a premise conjunct rather than a fused compound, the dependent indefinite object as a per-binding Skolem with its typing kept inside the denied bundle, and 'alone' as a depictive concurrent state inside the bundle (not a mis-slotted Manner) all follow the doctrine. Patient for 'tend' is borderline against the default-to-Theme instruction but is defensible under the treatment-verb reading (clean / fix / water).

fields.sentence: The Council permits an apprentice to begin solo tending.

q2_gaps: an ACTIVE lexical deontic verb ("the Council permits an apprentice to V"; likewise authorizes / allows / forbids): the instruction set gives deontic routing only for modals and for the passive/participial "Ns are permitted / are required / are forbidden to V", so it never says whether the complement of an active permission verb with its own granting subject additionally carries `(Permitted e)`, or stays a plain object-control complement with no status of its own (as the control-verb rule's "no tense / status of its own" implies)
review.notes: "The Council" correctly takes no `Name` atom (capitalized bare kind-word label = common noun by default), and the object-control pattern (controller's role copied into the complement, object never on the matrix verb), the inception shape (`Theme` = activity witness + `Ongoing`), and the no-status-on-bare-simple-present rule are all applied as written. `(Manner sk_tend_1 solo)` for "solo tending" is a judgment call, but "solo" is a manner-proper adverbial rather than one of the barred duration / sequence / scope / degree classes.
